This is the second regular chapter of the [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game XY!]] manga.

==Plot==
After [[Manabu Kadoo|Manabu]] and [[Hiroshi Uratane|Uratane]] each get the [[Xerneas Half Deck (TCG)|Xerneas]] and [[Yveltal Half Deck (TCG)|Yveltal half decks]], respectively, they rebuild them to better suit their play styles and immediately start to battle. It is then that Manabu learns that attacks need certain types of [[Energy card (TCG)|Energy]] in order to be used, due him attaching only {{TCG|Fairy}}-type Energy and failing to use his {{p|Talonflame}}'s {{m|Flare Blitz}} attack. Manabu loses the battle as a result of that blunder, and Uratane then explains to him that that [[type]] and number of Energy cards, as well as resistances in a deck, are very important when building one. Taking what Uratane said to heart, Manabu rebuilds his Xerneas deck with those aspects in mind to focus more on {{type|Fairy}}s, and challenges Uratane to another battle. Manabu easily wins thanks to the resistance to {{type|Dark}}s that Fairy-type Pokémon have.
